title: GPT-6-Astra Understands Touch and Outperform Vision--Tactile--Language--Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.28457v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: General-purpose multimodal models have shown promise as direct robot action policies, yet whether they grasp the physics underlying real-world interactions and can apply that understanding to guide action remains underexplored. We investigate this question using contact-rich manipulation as a representative testbed, examining tactile understanding as a concrete instance of this broader capability. Contact-rich manipulation requires interpreting tactile feedback and adjusting actions after obstruction. Existing learned tactile policies acquire these capabilities through specialized pretraining and per-task optimization, with substantial data and training costs. We present GPT-as-Tactile-Policy, which summarizes expert demonstrations into task guidance and tactile references for contact assessment and corrective action. translated_title: GPT-6-Astra 理解触觉并超越视觉-触觉-语言-动作模型
translated_abstract: 通用多模态模型作为直接的机器人动作策略已展现出前景，但它们是否真正掌握了现实世界交互背后的物理规律，并能否将这种理解应用于指导动作，仍然缺乏充分探索。我们以接触丰富的操作作为代表性测试平台来研究这一问题，将触觉理解作为这一更广泛能力的具体实例。接触丰富的操作需要解读触觉反馈并在受阻后调整动作。现有的学习型触觉策略需要通过专门的预训练和逐任务优化来获得这些能力，伴随着大量的数据和训练成本。我们提出了 GPT-as-Tactile-Policy（GPT 作为触觉策略）方法，将专家演示总结为任务指导和触觉参考，用于接触评估和纠正性动作。GPT-6-Astra 将这些上下文信息与多模态观察和交互历史相结合，以生成控制指令并……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 提出将 GPT-6-Astra 直接作为触觉策略的 GPT-as-Tactile-Policy 方法，通过将专家演示总结为任务指导与触觉参考，并结合多模态观察与交互历史生成控制指令，无需专门的预训练与逐任务优化即可实现接触丰富的操作并超越现有的视觉-触觉-语言-动作模型。
en_tdlr: Proposes GPT-as-Tactile-Policy, which leverages GPT-6-Astra as a direct tactile policy by summarizing expert demonstrations into task guidance and tactile references, combined with multimodal observations and interaction history to generate control commands, enabling contact-rich manipulation without specialized pretraining and outperforming vision-tactile-language-action models.
